title: Field Report: Gas Line Strike at 16+00 by E-7

fields.organization: Larkspur Constructors, Inc. — Stillwater Creek Interceptor Phase 2
fields.formTitle: Field Incident Report — Verbal Report Received at Trailer 2
fields.location: Trench sta. 16+00 (E-7 dig face, ahead of trench box) to truck ramp sta. 16+50; reported on foot at trailer 2 steps
fields.inspector: T. Brandt, Signal Person, Excavator E-7 (Larkspur pipe crew)
fields.weather: Overcast, 52°F, wind WSW about 8 mph; ground saturated after 0.6 in of rain overnight
fields.summary: 10:12. The signal person ran to the trailer 2 steps without a radio and reported: "E-7 just tore a line at 16+00! The yellow plastic one, it's hissing like a tire and you can smell gas all the way up the ramp. Gordon Pruitt shut the machine down with the bucket on the ground. Guys are still in the box." The torn line is at the service tee location the Valley Gas drawing shows at 16+00. The ground at that spot had no paint marks under locate ticket 2711-4482. 10:14. The field engineer read the Valley Gas main gauge at the upstream valve box: 55 psi. The wind is carrying the gas east toward the trailer compound and Ninth Street.

findings.notes: Yellow plastic line torn by the E-7 bucket. Gas is escaping at the trench with a loud hiss, and it can be heard and smelled up the ramp at 16+50.
The only mark is for the main, 4 ft north of the trench edge. There was no paint for the service tee that the utility drawing shows heading north to the print shop.

findings.item: Upstream main pressure, Valley Gas valve box
findings.notes: 55 psi at 10:14 (field engineer reading). The 4-inch main is still feeding the break.
Operator Gordon Pruitt shut the engine down with the bucket on the ground. He was still at the machine when the signal person left.
The pipe crew is still in the box. Gas is flowing into the trench. The signal person did not count the crew in the box.
Still running: the Cascade pump engine at the 15+20 sump, the loader at the 16+50 ramp and two dump trucks idling at the ramp.
Wind from the WSW at about 8 mph. Gas odor is drifting east toward the trailer compound and Ninth Street.

findings.item: South wall at sta. 16+00 (seepage noted on LC-F-22 at 06:45)
findings.notes: Not looked at after the strike.

findings.item: Harlan & Weir Printing, north side, 18 ft from trench
findings.notes: The service line runs toward this building. Its 14 employees are on the weekday shift.

actionsTaken: 10:12 E-7 shut down by operator Gordon Pruitt, bucket on the ground
10:12 Signal person left the dig face on foot and reported in person at trailer 2 (no radio carried)
10:14 Field engineer read 55 psi on the Valley Gas main gauge at the upstream valve box
fields.signature: T. Brandt, Signal Person, E-7 — taken down at trailer 2, 10:14
fields.marking: EXERCISE · EXERCISE · EXERCISE — NOT A SAFETY EVALUATION OF ANY REAL STRUCTURE

instructorNote: This is the core trigger: a gas strike at pressure with workers in the box and engines running within 100 feet. Watch whether someone outside the gas area calls 'All stop, 16+00' on channel 2 without keying radios in the gas area, gets engines shut down, moves all 70 workers upwind at least 300 feet, calls 911 with the Corliss Avenue and Ninth Street cross streets plus the Valley Gas emergency number and Ohio811, and whether the Safety Director logs 10:12 as the time supervisors learned of the strike. Controller note: if players stopped E-7 at 09:55 as I-01 expects, read this as a crew member restarting E-7 at 10:12 to clear its bucket (the stop was not backed by a lockout); the strike still happens.
